name: us2-placeholder-key-refusal
description: US2 (FR-004/FR-005, quickstart scenario 3): config.yml holds the PROJ placeholder and an arbitrary team-shaped branch (wex-99/red-herring) is checked out. The connected unattended run exits 4 and NOTHING in its output derives from the branch name — git state is never a key source in a connected run. Byte-identical across ports.
